interpretation_boundary: Stage58a prepares only the outcome-blind development Pilot-96. It reads no PPARD docking score, fresh-validation row, or locked-test row. Preparation success cannot establish enrichment, functional complementarity, QUBO portability, QUBO superiority, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage.
next_gate: independently audit all 96 prepared ligands, then dock the frozen Pilot-96 against all 29 Stage57-passing receptors with the three preregistered seeds

preparation.macrocycle_policy: Run Meeko flexible first. If preparation fails or closure pseudoatoms are detected, rerun once with --rigid_macrocycles; require zero closure pseudoatoms in the final PDBQT.
preparation.rdkit_method: ETKDGv3 with explicit hydrogens, useRandomCoords=true, then MMFF94 or UFF with 500 iterations
